name: query_entities
author: hprebar
title: Query entities
description: Finds entities by type, layer (wildcards), color, linetype, block name, text content, handle list, visibility and space, and returns them page by page (handle, type, layer, space, bounding box in mm, length, text, block name; detail mode adds tessellated geometry, area, attributes, position, color, linetype). Use this when the user asks what is on a layer, how many of something exist, to find blocks or text, or to get handles for other tools. Prefer a layer/type filter on big drawings; page with offset/limit. Read-only.

filter.description: Which entities to consider. Types, layers and block names accept AutoCAD wildcards (* and ?) and comma lists; handles short-circuit everything else.

types.description: DXF names: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, SPLINE, HATCH, SOLID, INSERT (block reference), TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, LEADER, MULTILEADER…

colors.description: ACI index as text ("1"), "ByLayer", "ByBlock" or a true-colour name

blockNames.description: Block definition names or wildcards (INSERT entities only)

textContains.description: Case-insensitive substring of the text / dimension text / block attribute values

handles.description: Exact entity handles (hex); when given, the other criteria only narrow this list

visibleOnly.description: Skip invisible entities and entities on off/frozen layers

space.description: model (default), current (the active layout), all, or a layout name

mode.description: summary = identity + bounds + text/block/length; detail = everything incl. geometry vertices (capped at 64 per entity and 20 entities per page)

properties.description: Return exactly these properties (plus handle/type/layer) instead of the mode's set

maxCandidates.description: Stop scanning after this many candidate entities (truncated=true in the result)
